title: Thermal Conversion
story: Your sensor reports Celsius, but the control room needs Fahrenheit.
lesson: Arithmetic works inside return statements. For Fahrenheit: multiply Celsius by 9/5, then add 32.
objective: Write to_fahrenheit(celsius) using the Celsius-to-Fahrenheit conversion.
hint: The calculation is celsius * 9 / 5 + 32. Return the result.
